inventory.contract: Ranking, navigation, frame-value and aggregate windows; named definitions; ROWS/GROUPS/RANGE with exclusions; row/selected partition keys and orders; typed numeric and interval distances. RowNumber/Rank/DenseRank -> int64, PercentRank/CumeDist -> float64, NTile -> int32; missing frame/offset values become nullable, aggregate result types retained.

64 row/selected and nullable function entry points including case normalization, trimming, concatenation, replacement, lengths and substrings; text inputs and integer positions retain owner/phase constraints.

Calendar/clock/instant families, explicit zones and date/timestamp units, extracts/truncation, epoch conversions, differences/shifts and transaction time; seconds/UnixSeconds use decimal, Date plus interval yields LocalDateTime; nullable variants and selected phase remain explicit.

Interval arithmetic, differences, calendar/elapsed components and temporal shifts; interval Sum/Avg already delivered in 6a3. Validated geographic origin and same-owner coordinates yield float64 great-circle metres, nullable when inputs are absent.

JSONKind distinguishes JSON null from SQL NULL; safe array Length -> nullable int64; payload-typed containment and row paths; generated Properties/At retain payload, key/index types and owner; path JSON/scalar reads are nullable. Handwritten path accessors need a design decision before 6d3; no model generator is added here.
